t_advice_summary_textbox.text: You get more points when you choose non earth coloured gnomes when it is 5x points.

vb_textbox.text: The gnomes are spilt into two categories, earthy coloured ones (brown, green, yellow) and very vibrant coloured ones (purple, pink, red). I noticed that choosing the very vibrant ones gave more points at most times but that also changed throughout the game.
